BiblicalUsage: The psaltery was one of the instruments in Nebuchadnezzar's band, sounded with cornet, flute, harp, sackbut and dulcimer. When the music played, everyone was to fall down and worship the golden image, and when the people heard it, they did.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that music is never neutral: here it was the signal for idolatry, and the three young men who would not bow heard the same notes and stood.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
